name: PMO Runtime MCP
description: PMO local runtime capability registration for mirror import, macro dashboard generation, preview, delivery guardrails, and change-alert analysis. Runtime implementation is provided by L3 local capability hooks.

tools.description: Import Lark Bitable markdown/json mirror files into PMO SQLite raw-record tables.
Generate and push PMO macro dashboard report to configured Lark channels.
Generate a PMO macro dashboard preview without sending.
Analyze PMO table changes and produce correction alerts when needed.
